factor_deficiency__hemophilia_a.subject: hemophilia_a
factor_deficiency__hemophilia_a.source: Hemophilia A is caused by a deficiency of coagulation factor VIII.

coag_inheritance__hemophilia_a.subject: hemophilia_a
coag_inheritance__hemophilia_a.source: Hemophilia A is inherited in an X-linked recessive pattern.

prolonged_test__hemophilia_a.subject: hemophilia_a
prolonged_test__hemophilia_a.source: Factor VIII deficiency prolongs the activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT) with a normal prothrombin time.

factor_deficiency__hemophilia_b.subject: hemophilia_b
factor_deficiency__hemophilia_b.source: Hemophilia B (Christmas disease) is caused by a deficiency of coagulation factor IX.

coag_inheritance__hemophilia_b.subject: hemophilia_b
coag_inheritance__hemophilia_b.source: Hemophilia B is inherited in an X-linked recessive pattern.

prolonged_test__hemophilia_b.subject: hemophilia_b
prolonged_test__hemophilia_b.source: Factor IX deficiency prolongs the activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT) with a normal prothrombin time.

factor_deficiency__von_willebrand_diseas.subject: von_willebrand_disease
factor_deficiency__von_willebrand_diseas.source: Von Willebrand disease results from a quantitative or qualitative deficiency of von Willebrand factor.

coag_inheritance__von_willebrand_disease.subject: von_willebrand_disease
coag_inheritance__von_willebrand_disease.source: Von Willebrand disease (the common type 1) is inherited in an autosomal dominant pattern.

prolonged_test__von_willebrand_disease.subject: von_willebrand_disease
prolonged_test__von_willebrand_disease.source: Von Willebrand disease classically prolongs the bleeding time because von Willebrand factor mediates platelet adhesion.

factor_deficiency__factor_vii_deficiency.subject: factor_vii_deficiency
factor_deficiency__factor_vii_deficiency.source: Factor VII deficiency is a deficiency of coagulation factor VII of the extrinsic pathway.

coag_inheritance__factor_vii_deficiency.subject: factor_vii_deficiency
coag_inheritance__factor_vii_deficiency.source: Factor VII deficiency is inherited in an autosomal recessive pattern.

prolonged_test__factor_vii_deficiency.subject: factor_vii_deficiency
prolonged_test__factor_vii_deficiency.source: Factor VII deficiency prolongs the prothrombin time (PT) in isolation, with a normal activated partial thromboplastin time.

factor_deficiency__hemophilia_c.subject: hemophilia_c
factor_deficiency__hemophilia_c.source: Hemophilia C is caused by a deficiency of coagulation factor XI.

coag_inheritance__hemophilia_c.subject: hemophilia_c
coag_inheritance__hemophilia_c.source: Hemophilia C (factor XI deficiency) is inherited in an autosomal recessive pattern.

prolonged_test__hemophilia_c.subject: hemophilia_c
prolonged_test__hemophilia_c.source: Factor XI deficiency prolongs the activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT).
